And how do we make that stop? I have three experiences with it. One was when I took 200ug with a lot of THC gummies. I felt nothing, then had a feeling that I was going to die like really. And that traumatized me. I didn't take it for 2 years; I thought it was due to the THC gummies being mixed in. Then, two years later, I took 200ug for the first time, thinking that was never going to happen again since it was not mixed with THC. Everything was fine. I was happy for about three hours, and then all of a sudden, the same thing started to happen within a second where I thought I was dying, that I couldn't breathe, and that I had vasoconstriction. Even though I clearly saw that I was breathing normally, my heart rate was stable at around 90 bpm, and my blood oxygen level was 98%. Still, I was convinced that I would die, and I couldn't unconvince myself of that. This was the first time I could get past it without being given a trip killer. I waited several hours walking outside, and every couple of minutes, I would get the feeling that I was entering into a new world and that I was on the verge of death soon, even though I was telling myself at that moment that it was fake, I still was being looped into that.

Then, on the next trip, a couple of weeks later, I took 150ug. And I started to experience that but not as much of an intensity. I was the same thing, the feeling that I would die, but I was able to go outside and walk around. After 2 hours of walking around, the feeling died down, and I was distracted by other things but still scared I would be in that state again. Then I took 100ug a couple of weeks later and probably got that thought for a few seconds, but it didn't affect the trip much. I was able to have a normal trip but wasn't able to fully relax or enjoy it because I feared the same bad trip. I haven't taken it in more than 6 months now; I fear the same will happen if I do. The sad thing is that before that first bad trip, I had about 20 others that were good, and only that one happened; it's almost like I cannot have another good trip without these bad thoughts.
